name: open-webui
description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
one_liner: A self-hosted ChatGPT-style web app your company runs on its own servers, so staff get an AI chat interface without sending data to an outside AI company.
buyer: An IT manager at a law firm, hospital, or bank who needs staff to use AI chat but is barred by compliance from sending client data to a public AI vendor.
business_use_cases: A law firm or clinic self-hosts it so staff can use AI chat and document search without client data ever leaving their own servers.
A managed IT provider resells a hosted, locked-down version of it to small businesses that want 'private ChatGPT' without running their own servers.
A company uses its built-in scheduling and persistent memory features to replace several smaller internal tools (notes, reminders, simple automations) with one AI-powered workspace.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a managed hosting + support package for regulated businesses (legal, healthcare, finance) that need a private AI chat.
Offer paid setup and integration (connecting internal documents, SSO, user permissions) for companies self-hosting it.

steal_this: Package a locked-down, pre-configured version of this for one regulated niche (e.g. law firms) with document search built in, and sell it as 'private AI chat, set up in a day.'
